primaryText: Moses gave to them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan; the land, according to its cities and borders, even the cities of the surrounding land.
reasonJa: 原文はモーセがガド族等へ王国と土地を与えたと明記する。地域カードはこの割当関係の補助説明で、ガドという町の直接明記や新しい境界点の証明ではない。
